newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chemical tanker drifting in Tokyo Bay--coast guard.
newsitem.headline: Chemical tanker drifting in Tokyo Bay--coast guard.

text.p: A coastal tanker carrying 495 tonnes of propylene was abandoned by its crew in Tokyo Bay on Thursday after the ship listed slightly because of a coolant water leak, Japan's Maritime Safety Agency said.
The agency, the country's coast guard, did not say how the leak caused the ship to list.
The agency said tug boats had been dispatched to help the ship.
Propylene, which vapourises at minus 47.7 degrees Celsius, is usually transported in the form of liquid.
There appears to have been no propylene leaks, the agency said, adding traffic in the bay has not been affected.
